{{Top|leg}}
'''''Resro''''' was a group of two [[Class-G cargo container|Class-G Cargo Containers]] used by the Imperial Navy during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

During the [[Attack on Omar|First Battle of Omar]] in the [[Zaarin insurrection]]'s [[Strategic Warfare]] campaign, the ''Resro'' group of Class-G Cargo Containers, composed of ''[[Resro 1]]'' and ''[[Resro 2]]'', were part of [[TIE pilot|TIE Pilot]] [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele's]] defense forces for the [[Deep Space Manufacturing Facility|Deep Space Manufacturing Facilities]] [[Omar (Deep Space Manufacturing Facilities)|Omar]].
